close_reason: Public-API change: BlobUploadResponse.sha256 from Option<String> to typed digest. Wire format unchanged but caller-visible type changes. Deferred to 0.2.0; could land alongside JMAP-6by7's typed-Id pass since both replace stringy fields with typed newtypes.
description: src/blob.rs:65 — `pub sha256: Option<String>`. The field is a hex digest validated by is_valid_sha256_hex (length 64, all hex). A newtype `pub struct Sha256Hex([u8; 32]);` with a Deserialize impl that validates and decodes once would: (a) make the validation enforced by the type system, (b) eliminate the runtime is_valid_sha256_hex() call at the comparison site, (c) eliminate the to_ascii_lowercase() normalization (digest stored as bytes is case-free), (d) make local_sha256 vs server_sha256 comparison a simple == on [u8; 32]. The compute_sha256_hex() helper that builds a String just to compare to another String is a code smell — the natural type is the underlying 32 bytes. `expected_sha256: Option<&'a str>` on DownloadBlobParams has the same issue. Note: locked crate.
title: BlobUploadResponse.sha256 is Option<String> rather than a typed digest
